title: Skin Standalone TypeScript SDK first slice: producer-verified anonymous-window operations
objective: Deliver the first Skin TypeScript SDK package (@mc-plan/skin-sdk@0.1.0-alpha.1, private, local pack only) on the locked skin.yaml 0.1.0-alpha.1 contract and the MCP-F1-SKIN-008/009 producer evidence (skin main 14a8fe3), exposing all eight producer-verified Standalone anonymous-window operations with typed SKIN problem codes, abort/timeout and bounded key-stable idempotent retries.
in_scope: New sdk/skin package mirroring the sdk/community discipline: openapi-typescript deterministic generation from the in-repo locked openapi/skin.yaml with committed raw generator output and .prettierignore exemption for src/generated and dist

SUPPORTED_OPERATIONS covering all eight operations (createConversation, createRender, finalizeSkin, getJob, getConversation, deleteConversation, getCandidatePreview, downloadSkin); SUPPORTED_PRODUCER_COMMIT anchored at skin 14a8fe3; SUPPORTED_CONTRACT_FILES embedding the sha256 of every generation-input contract file (skin.yaml plus the referenced common problem schema)

Anonymous-window client with NO credential model: the SDK never takes token providers and never sends credential headers (ADR-0012); typed ProblemDetails for the ten producer-stable SKIN_* codes; AbortSignal and configurable timeout; bounded idempotent retries that never rotate the Idempotency-Key (three keyed commands plus five GETs are contract-idempotent); binary preview/download returning bytes plus mediaType with client-side PNG magic and 64x64 IHDR pre-validation; client-side pre-validation of message lengths, key 8..200, title 1..120, description bounds and the arm-model enum

Unit tests per exposed operation (transport/path/auth-free surface/retry/idempotency boundaries/problem parsing/binary assertions), pack:check clean-project strict-tsc consumption, real HTTP smoke against the producer tree (skin main 14a8fe3) running from the neighboring read-only checkout with session-unique manually-started PostgreSQL and Redis containers and the deterministic fake provider (honest attribution: no LLM/image provider involved and Q-001 untouched): full create - render-poll - preview - finalize-poll - download - detail - delete chain, idempotent same-key replay and SKIN_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, attempts-exhausted 409, unknown/expired-deleted 404 families, delete cascade non-resurrection, and no clock manipulation of the retention windows

Contracts docs sync: STATUS, development-plan, api-catalog Skin SDK coverage, compatibility Skin SDK acceptance section and matrix row, AGENTS three official SDK packages; generate:check zero drift with validate_contracts.py and redocly re-run
out_of_scope: Any change to skin.yaml, JSON schemas or other contract files (contract zero drift)
Any write to the mc-plan-skin repository (producer evidence is read-only; its containers run from the clean checkout)
Official-mode userOAuth flows (documentational only in ADR-0012), vendor binding or Q-001/Q-011/Q-012/Q-013 decisions, F3 Official integration, retention-window clock manipulation
npm publishing, stable versions, claiming any real consumer has integrated the Skin SDK

direction_exception.authorized_by: MC Plan project owner, 2026-10-16 blanket directive to read the whole MC plan, complete every remaining module development and keep iterating to completion (this session start)
direction_exception.reason: Owner-directed continuation of the F1 Skin/Contracts line under the active F2 direction (SKIN-009/OPS-004 precedent): exposes the already producer-verified Standalone anonymous-window surface only, keeps Q-001 vendor binding undecided, changes no contract and claims no F2 exit criteria.

validation_results: Implementation complete on feat/MCP-F1-CONTRACTS-007-skin-sdk (two commits on base 1409762: b7cde65 SDK feature 23 files +5011 + 601c0f3 docs). All final-tree gates green: format:check, lint --max-warnings 0, strict typecheck (noUncheckedIndexedAccess/exactOptionalPropertyTypes), generate:check byte-zero drift with openapi/schemas/events/examples unchanged, 29 unit tests, build, pack:check clean-consumer strict-tsc (tarball mc-plan-skin-sdk-0.1.0-alpha.1.tgz), validate_contracts.py (31 schemas/events, 31 unique ids, 3 OpenAPI documents, 43 operationIds) and redocly three-document lint (1 expected skin.yaml warning).

Real HTTP smoke:real exit 0 twice (runs 3 and 4) against the producer tree (skin main 14a8fe3, SUPPORTED_PRODUCER_COMMIT anchor) running from the neighboring read-only checkout: node-spawned api + worker with SKIN_PROVIDER=fake, SKIN_RUN_MODE=standalone, session-unique manually-started PostgreSQL 17 and Redis 7 containers (the established local workaround for the testcontainers strategy probe) and a session temp SKIN_CANDIDATE_STORAGE_ROOT; honest attribution: no LLM or image model involved, no paid credentials read, Q-001 untouched, candidates are fixture quality proving the SDK and the anonymous-window protocol, not model quality. Full chain through the SDK: create (field-closed conversation, attempts 0/3) - same-key/same-request replay returns the original conversation and same-key/different-request 409 SKIN_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT - render 202 + job poll to succeeded with candidate_id (field-closed Job) - candidate preview bytes (image/png, SDK 64x64 PNG/IHDR pre-validation) and unknown candidate 404 SKIN_CANDIDATE_NOT_FOUND - conversation detail with field-closed message history and attempts 1/3 - finalize 202 + poll to succeeded with resource_id, same-key replay returns the original job - finalized download bytes and unknown resource 404 SKIN_RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND - finalize after completion 409 SKIN_CONVERSATION_NOT_ACTIVE - second conversation: three queued renders then the fourth 409 SKIN_ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED - unknown job/conversation 404 SKIN_JOB_NOT_FOUND/SKIN_CONVERSATION_NOT_FOUND - delete 204 void then detail/preview/download all 404 with no resurrection; no clock manipulation (24h/30d retention windows only read as metadata); zero credential leaks in smoke logs and zero leftover containers, volumes or processes.

Harness findings fixed during smoke authoring (test-only): the manually published Redis URL must not append the container port after the dynamic host port (bullmq/ioredis ERR_INVALID_URL surfaced as producer 500 SKIN_INTERNAL before the fix); producer child diagnostics are captured and printed on failure.
